rationale: The Court is likely to reject a per se waiver/forfeiture rule and hold that, absent an express appellate limitation, the district court on remand retains discretion to consider a first amendment under Rule 15 as constrained by the mandate and ordinary post-judgment/finality considerations. Roberts is best positioned to write a narrow, institutionally cautious opinion emphasizing no automatic “do-over” while leaving district courts to police gamesmanship through Foman factors and post-judgment standards.
